title: Critical dependency unavailable
narrative: At 08:30 UTC ransomware encrypts the Orders API servers. The API's own backups are intact. While investigating, responders find the attacker had disabled and scheduled deletion of the customer-managed key that encrypts the orders database backups (08:35 UTC). The database is down and its recovery points cannot be decrypted. Restoring the API alone will not bring the service back.

injections.description: Ransomware encrypted the Orders API application servers.

injections.reason: Backup encryption key disabled and pending deletion; recovery points cannot be decrypted
injections.description: Attacker disabled the customer-managed key for database backups. The database instance was also terminated.

recommended_actions: Cancel the key deletion and re-enable the key (the provider's waiting period allows this)
Do not bring up the Orders API until the database is available
Use an isolated copy encrypted with a different key
